cases.question: According to Transformation-Based Learning in the Fast Lane, how does the method improve transformation-based learning speed?

observed.answer: The paper proposes a novel, realistic method that significantly reduces the training time of a transformation-based learner [1]. It still achieves the same performance as a standard transformation-based learner [1].

factual_claims.claim: The method significantly reduces training time.
The method achieves the same performance as a standard transformation-based learner.
